help.title: How It Works?
help.url:
A URL QR code directs the user to a website when scanned.

Enter the full URL (including https://). The browser opens automatically when scanned.
help.text:
A Text QR code displays free text when scanned.

You can add notes, messages or any text content. No internet connection required.
help.wifi:
A Wi-Fi QR code automatically connects the device to the specified network when scanned.

Enter the network name (SSID), password and encryption type. Let your guests connect easily.
help.phone:
A Phone QR code prepares a call to the specified number when scanned.

Enter the phone number including country code. The scanner can call with a single tap.
help.sms:
An SMS QR code creates a ready message to the specified number when scanned.

Enter the phone number and optional message text.
help.email:
An Email QR code opens a new email draft when scanned.

Enter the recipient address, subject and message content. The scanner can send it directly.
help.vcard:
A Contact QR code allows adding contact info to the phonebook when scanned.

Enter name, phone, email and company info. Can be used instead of a business card.
help.location:
A Location QR code opens the specified coordinates in a map app when scanned.

Enter latitude and longitude values. Ideal for sharing business or event locations.
help.social:
A Social Media QR code redirects to the specified platform when scanned.

Select a platform and enter your username. Make it easy for followers to find you.
help.appStore:
An App Store QR code opens your app's store page when scanned.

Select a platform and enter the store URL. Make it easy for users to download your app.
help.crypto:
A Crypto Wallet QR code transfers payment information when scanned.

Select a cryptocurrency, enter your wallet address and optionally an amount.
